testo:
Justdiver Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature or it attacks, choose one of your opponent's creatures and put it into its owner's hyperspatial zone.
■ Whenever a card is put into your opponent's hyperspatial zone, your opponent puts the top 2 cards of their deck into their graveyard.
testo_jp:
Justdiver Triple Breaker
■ このクリーチャーが出た時または攻撃する時、相手のクリーチャーを1体選び、持ち主の超次元ゾーンに置く。
■ カードが相手の超次元ゾーンに置かれた時、相手は自身の山札の上から2枚を墓地に置く。

lato_b.testo:
■ Choose up to 3 cards from your opponent's graveyard and put them into their owner's hyperspatial zone.
■ Put the top card of your deck into your mana zone.
lato_b.testo_jp:
■ カードを3枚まで相手の墓地から選び、持ち主の超次元ゾーンに置く。
■ 自分の山札の上から1枚をマナゾーンに置く。
